email.body1:
Luis, saw XOi launched Advisor and partnered with ECM Technologies to modernize HVAC maintenance nationwide.

A nationwide push like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for XOi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Luis, quick follow-up for XOi.

With Advisor and the ECM partnership widening the funnel, the target usually outruns headcount. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings XOi needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Luis, last bit of proof for XOi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how XOi's reply rate likely compares to other field-service software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Luis, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A nationwide rollout is its own kind of busy, and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to XOi either way.
